name: Morok G2 Reinforcement Feedback Database
description: Isolated feedback episodes and signed rewards for G2's two independent experts. The bootstrap corpus contains three controlled question-answer examples in one text file.

policy.algorithm: reward-weighted BPTT score-gradient surrogate applied independently to both G2 experts
policy.note: Controlled lexical grader; not a general semantic judge.
